title: Sub-10s warm cargo fast-release on Windows x86_64 via toolchain env preservation, idempotent binary staging, and OS-process soak filters
goal: Achieve <10s warm inner-loop build + test + release execution (`cargo fast-release` `total_ms < 10_000`) on Windows x86_64 (`x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`): preserve `CARGO_HOME` and `RUSTUP_HOME` across isolated test sandboxes so child `cargo`/`rustc` invocations never re-download the toolchain; skip redundant 50 MB PE binary overwrites in `stage_one_binary` when byte-identical to avoid Windows Defender synchronous re-scan overhead; collapse `read_git_provenance` into a single `git rev-parse` process; and filter Windows multi-second OS-process (`tasklist`, `netstat`, `git`, `rustc`), NTFS `FlushFileBuffers` loop, and loopback TCP SYN-retransmit timeout soak tests into `skipped_soak_tests` (`--full-soak` runs all of them).
limitations: Soak filters skipped in the default <10s inner loop remain recorded verbatim in `verification.skipped_soak_tests` and execute under `cargo fast-release --full-soak`.
